name: game-asset-explorer
description: Asset DevTools for managing game image assets in VS Code.

commands.title: Game Asset Explorer: Open Asset Grid
Game Asset Explorer: Configure Asset Directories
Game Asset Explorer: Set OpenAI API Key

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a game project folder to start exploring image assets.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)

Choose the folders that contain your game images.
[Configure Asset Directories](command:gameAssetExplorer.configureAssetDirectories)

Browse and inspect the configured game image assets.
[Open Asset Grid](command:gameAssetExplorer.openAssetGrid)
[Configure Asset Directories](command:gameAssetExplorer.configureAssetDirectories)

gameAssetExplorer.assetDirectories.description: Workspace-relative directories to scan recursively for image assets.

enumDescriptions: RPG categories such as Character, Enemy, Item, Equipment, Skill, Map, UI, and Effect.
Action-game categories such as Character, Enemy, Weapon, Projectile, Stage, UI, and Effect.
Visual-novel categories such as Character, Expression, Background, CG, UI, and Effect.
Card-game categories such as Card, Character, Frame, Icon, Effect, and Background.
Use the categories configured in gameAssetExplorer.customAssetTypes.
gameAssetExplorer.assetProfile.description: Game genre / Asset Profile used for semantic asset-type classification and filtering.

gameAssetExplorer.customAssetTypes.description: Asset types available when the active Asset Profile is Custom.
